persona: Brand social media lead with five years running Instagram and creator programmes for a D2C food brand
resumeText:
Meera Nair | Bengaluru | meera.nair@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Social Media Lead, Kappa Foods Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru (2022 - present)
- Own the monthly social media content calendar for Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn with a team of two designers.
- Run community management for 1.2 lakh followers, replying to DMs and moderating comments daily.
- Plan instagram reels and YouTube Shorts with the video editor, two to three every week.
- Manage influencer campaigns with 40 food creators a quarter, from shortlisting to briefs and payments.
- Write captions and copywriting for posts, carousels and festive campaigns in the brand voice.
- Share monthly social media reporting on reach, saves and engagement rate with the marketing head.
- Brief the design agency every week and present campaign results to the founders.

Social Media Executive, Pepper Lane Agency, Kochi (2020 - 2022)
- Posted daily content for restaurant and cafe clients and replied to customer comments.

EDUCATION
BA Mass Communication, Mahatma Gandhi University, 2020

SKILLS
Meta Ads, Canva, Hootsuite
